summary: Static technical audit against the expanded file (node scripts/expand-md.js — no-op here: file has zero {{prompt:}} markers and zero inline **Prompt** fences) + four compendiums (platform_and_boundaries, research_claims, prompts, pedagogy technical subset). This is a 3-slide M4-opener 'container' lecture: an SVG map-reveal figure plus two short prose sections (long-running governors, first un-packaged run). It carries NO platform-capability claims (grepped body + maintainer block for claude/cowork/session/skill/MCP/subagent — zero hits), NO citations/URLs/statistics, NO [Skill: ] references, and NO fenced/registry prompts — so nearly the entire ledger below resolves N/A by content-absence, which is itself the correct verdict for a pure narrative/diagram opener. Two items were independently verified rather than defaulted to N/A: (1) the maintainer block's SVG-derivation claim (ids re-prefixed wm- to fh- to avoid duplicate-id defs-collisions when the theory handbook renders multiple map copies on one page) checks out — only one id attribute exists in the SVG (id="fh-wall", correctly prefixed, no leftover wm-); (2) the file's Quality stamp (compendium-audited 2026-07-08, slides@47f3357) is tooling-written and 47f3357 verified as a real ancestor of HEAD via git merge-base -- however the file was touched AFTER that stamp (commit 327615a, 2026-07-10, replaced the ASCII banner with the current SVG figure) -- the maintainer block already self-flags this ('unreviewed... Re-audit before ship'), so this is a disclosed, non-blocking staleness the orchestrator's update-quality.sh should resolve after this verdict, not a hidden defect. No blocking findings.
